notifications.note: oscarhenrycollins/notifications main 1cc652fe: wizard18-wizard29 after 46cd17cf. wizard18: notification routes stored on the box (Chats, Badge, Daily or Off per source) and api/daily for the Morning Report's Overnight section; wizard19: api/routes names each source; wizard20: Morning Report sections get routes (report:<section id>); wizard21: phone router - Chats-routed items stream to the WizardOS Android app over Tailscale (SSE, since-cursor catch-up, no Google push), first app feed shows quietly; wizard22: scheduled jobs and agent notes can name the app they are about (CRON_JOB_APPS, notify app=<id>); wizard23: friendlier phone inbox layout; wizard24: fixes wizard23's restart loop (minimal view shipped zlib+base64 so the inlined front stays under Linux's 128 KiB per-argument limit); wizard25: scheduled-job relay drops runs that end in [SILENT] on their own line; wizard26: the agent's own notifications always wait in Chats; wizard27: CRON_TRUSTED_JOBS (agent review jobs are not failures for mentioning 'failed') and [CRON_FAILURE] honored; wizard28: compose passes CRON_TRUSTED_JOBS; wizard29: a run ending in NO_CHANGE is silent like [SILENT]. Images unchanged from 46cd17cf (same digest-pinned front python:3.12-alpine@sha256:1b668429b3511ab407d8e00648891631b0b1a4d7e15e3ca70f38ab5b91ad4ab4 and engine binwiederhier/ntfy:v2.29.0@sha256:4c599cf0818965782f93f652bd843e92714992e84d6b88ad17713dc0951cda1f). No migration: volumes unchanged (${APP_DATA_DIR}/inbox:/data, hermes-cron read-only, ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/var/lib/ntfy); routes.json and phone.sqlite3 are created on first use inside the existing /data volume; new optional settings (CRON_JOB_APPS, CRON_TRUSTED_JOBS, PHONE_OWNER_LOGIN) default to empty.
